html:
Visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, you will experience a wild space, but still exudes natural beauty. Cuc Phuong National Park is located in Ninh Binh and borders Thanh Hoa and Hoa Binh, a place with its own beauty, especially the most beautiful place in the butterfly season, with butterflies fluttering and many colorful fireflies, a beautiful and poetic picture of the countryside.

If you have the opportunity to travel Ninh Binh, visit Cuc Phuong National Park and encounter a diverse nature reserve, this place not only develops eco-tourism but also brings cultural and historical values.

Cuc Phuong National Park stands out with its diverse eco-tourism and tropical forests. Coming here, you will admire the wild and peaceful natural scenery, in the fresh air surrounded by cool primeval forests, with many species of wild animals and plants, and there is also a museum of rich flora and fauna.

Visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, you will encounter ancient trees that are hundreds of years old, the forest is covered with cool shade, the most beautiful stop every summer.

In addition, when traveling to Cuc Phuong National Park, you will encounter rare animals such as langurs, civets, striped civets and rare animals or beautiful birds. You can walk and admire the peaceful scenery.

Many who travel Ninh Binh tour and visit Cuc Phuong National Park often choose to cycle and immerse themselves in nature, while walking and enjoying the scenery or recording the most beautiful moments as souvenirs.

Cuc Phuong National Park also has attractions such as the wildlife rescue center, from here you can learn about the protection of wildlife, or admire the scenery from the limestone mountains overlooking the entire national park.

So when you come to explore Cuc Phuong National Park, you will not only admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, but also bring visitors the most relaxing moments away from the hustle and bustle of the city, immerse yourself in a peaceful space, listen to the chirping of birds, watch rare animals, help you love nature more.

The most beautiful time to travel to Cuc Phuong National Park is the butterfly season, starting from April to the end of May, this is the butterfly and firefly season in the cool weather here, butterflies in Cuc Phuong National Park start to be beautiful from April 10 every year.

Many tourists who travel to Cuc Phuong National Park butterfly season often choose the evening when the fireflies flash, creating a beautiful space, along with colorful butterflies flying in the sky, making many tourists feel excited.

Especially children when traveling to Ninh Binh during butterfly season are very excited, in addition, this is also the season when Cuc Phuong National Park has many wildflowers blooming, so it is very suitable for butterflies to develop.

Cuc Phuong National Park has many species of butterflies such as white butterflies, star butterflies, swallowtail butterflies, phalaenopsis butterflies, … in the butterfly season, the butterflies fluttering like a beautiful summer painting, especially when the night falls, the fireflies fluttering create a magical picture, this is also the time when Cuc Phuong attracts the most visitors.

Camping in Cuc Phuong garden, and watching wildlife

If you travel to Cuc Phuong from September to December, this is the dry season, a good time for visitors to experience camping and explore the wildlife here, and bring flashlights, sleeping bags, cameras, binoculars, cameras, insect repellent and personal belongings to conquer the forest roads…

In addition, you should not go to Cuc Phuong in the rainy season when the weather is wet, making it more difficult to travel. Especially Cuc Phuong in the rainy season has a lot of insects.

Cuc Phuong cuisine.

When coming here, visitors will enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: mountain goat, Muong pig, hill chicken… In Cuc Phuong, there are many restaurants where visitors can enjoy dishes with local specialties.
